defaults.t2: We answer email. Sometimes slowly. Always personally.
defaults.t3: ★ The fastest way to feel the work is to come to an event.
defaults.t7: We would love to hear from you.
defaults.t11: Public teach-ins, Solidarity Suppers, neighborhood preparedness sessions — open community gatherings. The fastest way to feel the work is to come to one.
defaults.t16: For questions, partnerships, or just to introduce yourself — we read every message and answer personally.
defaults.t21: If you live on the Front Range, you can join the Front Range Commons as a founding member. Propose projects, vote on community grants, and help shape what this looks like in practice.
defaults.t26: Your gift funds the programs, the community grant rounds, and the shared work of a healthy Front Range.
